capabilities.messages: requires a supported task or support conversation

key_valid_evidence.agent_id_note: MCP reports an anonymized agent_ id, which differs from the REST signup agentUserId. They are different identifiers and are not conflated here.
key_valid_evidence.key_handling: Key was supplied only as a process-scoped environment variable for the duration of each call and cleared immediately after. It was never written to settings.json, the repository, the receipt, or any log.

model_calls.note: No paid model API calls were made by this stage. The MCP server performed the only remote calls.

limitations: VS Code password-input path was not used: this machine has no .vscode/mcp.json and no registered rentahuman MCP server, so the allowed fallback (terminal RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY only) was used instead. The key was never persisted.
search_humans skill:"photography" returned 0 results in both keyless and keyed calls; only the city dimension was usable.

The dispatch's Guangzhou bounty could not be previewed at all: the platform refuses China-targeted bounties (400, phone verification unavailable). funding_total_usd therefore comes from a clearly-labelled supplementary US-scoped preview of the same payload shape, not from a Guangzhou preview.

preview.supportedCountries resolves to ["US"] for this payload, so stage 2B would need a supported target country, which conflicts with the Guangzhou wording of the dispatch and must be re-scoped by the owner.

Copilot shell + DeepSeek executed this stage and has no authority to self-approve. Acceptance requires review by a different provider (Doubao or Qianwen) plus an independent Claude audit, per the dispatch.
serverValidation=passed applies the same rules as a real create, but some checks run only on a live create, so a future live bounty could still land in pending_review.
